data.long_meaning: From the Old German words 'hisl' meaning 'stranger' or 'traveler' and 'heri' meaning 'army' or 'warrior'. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hessler usually hope their child will grow to embody stranger, traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
